note: gen: g1 warm-paper era, g2 neutral-app era, g3 poster-headline era (r5). tier: floor = never unless the brief names it; reflex = allowed with a one-line reason. evidence = finding id in FINDINGS.md (F#) or source file.

items.name: Warm paper
items.text: A cream or beige page (around #F4F1EA) with a high-contrast serif display and a terracotta, rust or clay accent. For a warm, bookish, calm or crafted subject, treat the first palette that comes to mind as already spent.

items.name: Neon night
items.text: A near-black page with one acid-green, neon or vermilion accent and glowing edges.

items.name: Broadsheet as decoration
items.text: Hairline rules everywhere, plus zero radius, plus dense newspaper columns, plus an italic serif display, on a subject that is not a publication.

items.name: Neutral app shell
items.text: A pale cool-grey or white page (around #E9EDF1–#F7F8FA) where colour appears only as one accent on buttons and one headline word, with white large-radius cards and pill buttons on every section. Saturated colour, a tinted ground or a dark ground are all open to you.

items.name: Poster headline
items.text: A heavy grotesk headline set in ALL CAPS or very tight, often Archivo or Archivo Black, filling the hero, with a cobalt or navy accent and a white or pale ground. Let the headline get its character from the assigned faces and from the direction instead.

items.name: The emphasised word
items.text: A headline where one word or phrase is switched to italic, or to the accent colour, or to a second typeface, to add personality. Give the headline character through size, weight, width, case, setting or layout instead.

items.name: One corner habit
items.text: Every card, button, input and image given the same treatment by habit: all pills and 16px+ cards, or all square boxes with 1–2px borders. Choose corners per role (controls, containers, media) and let at least two roles differ.

items.name: Template chrome
items.text: A small tracked-out ALL-CAPS label above every heading, "01 / 02 / 03" markers on content that is not a sequence, meta strings joined with middle dots, monospace for small labels that are not code or data, a thick coloured stripe down one side of cards, hard offset shadows (4px 4px 0) outside a world that actually calls for them, and a row of identical icon + heading + text cards.

items.name: Fashionable effects
items.text: A purple-to-blue or purple-to-pink gradient hero; gradient-filled text; glass panels (backdrop-filter blur) as decoration; glowing coloured halos; a fine grid or line-field background on a page that is not a map, plan or measurement surface; emoji used as icons or section markers.

items.name: Habit typefaces
items.text: Display or body faces chosen by habit: Fraunces, Newsreader, Cormorant / Cormorant Garamond, Instrument Serif, Playfair Display, IBM Plex (Sans, Serif, Mono), Space Grotesk, Inter, Bricolage Grotesque, Figtree.
